ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Adroit Industries IPO at a median premium of ₹34 — the midpoint of 7 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹28 to ₹41. The median has climbed ₹1.5 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 38.2% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹134 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 25.37%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 5.18× overall — healthy. The issue is open for bidding now (23-25 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (65/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Adroit Industries IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 28 Sep, with listing expected 30 Sep 2026. For the Adroit Industries IPO, one lot is 111 shares and the issue size is ₹150.71 Cr. See also Adroit Industries IPO subscription status and Adroit Industries IPO allotment status. This Adroit Industries IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the ArMee Infotech IPO at a median premium of ₹54 — the midpoint of 7 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹1 to ₹56. That is ₹42 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Note the disagreement: trackers are 101.9% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹375 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 14.4%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.56× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (23-25 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (56/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the ArMee Infotech IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 28 Sep, with listing expected 30 Sep 2026. For the ArMee Infotech IPO, one lot is 40 shares and the issue size is 300.00 Cr. See also ArMee Infotech IPO subscription status and ArMee Infotech IPO allotment status. This ArMee Infotech IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Swastika Infra IPO at a median premium of ₹8 — the midpoint of 7 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹7 to ₹10. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 37.5% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹185 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 4.32%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (23-25 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (59/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Swastika Infra IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 28 Sep, with listing expected 30 Sep 2026. For the Swastika Infra IPO, one lot is 81 shares and the issue size is ₹161 Cr. See also Swastika Infra IPO subscription status and Swastika Infra IPO allotment status. This Swastika Infra IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

Elevate Campuses IPO is a Mainboard issue currently being tracked, with no grey market premium (GMP) quoted for it yet on gmptoday.in.

As of today, the Varmora Granito IPO grey market premium is ₹0.5 at the median of 6 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹0 and ₹3. Measured off the ₹148 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 0.34%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.27× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (22-24 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is low (34/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Varmora Granito IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 25 Sep, with listing expected 29 Sep 2026. For the Varmora Granito IPO, one lot is 101 shares and the issue size is ₹708.02 Cr. See also Varmora Granito IPO subscription status and Varmora Granito IPO allotment status. This Varmora Granito IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

No Himalaya Nutravedics IPO grey market premium has been reported yet — all 4 trackers we monitor currently quote ₹0, which usually means grey-market activity simply hasn't started. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.36× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (22-24 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. No confidence grade is published while no tracker is quoting a premium — there would be nothing for it to measure.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the Himalaya Nutravedics IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 25 Sep, with listing expected 29 Sep 2026. For the Himalaya Nutravedics IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹26.50 Cr. See also Himalaya Nutravedics IPO subscription status and Himalaya Nutravedics IPO allotment status. This Himalaya Nutravedics IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

As of today, the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO grey market premium is ₹73 at the median of 6 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹60 and ₹78. The median has climbed ₹4 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Trackers differ by about 24.7% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹118 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 61.86%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 304.06× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (70/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 22 Sep, with listing expected 24 Sep 2026. For the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹42.52 Cr. See also SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO subscription status and SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO allotment status. This SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Robokidz Eduventures IPO at a median premium of ₹65 — the midpoint of 7 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹55 to ₹66. The median has climbed ₹1 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Trackers differ by about 16.9% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹106 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 61.32%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 833.37× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (85/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the Robokidz Eduventures IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 24 Sep, with listing expected 28 Sep 2026. For the Robokidz Eduventures IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹31.09 Cr. See also Robokidz Eduventures IPO subscription status and Robokidz Eduventures IPO allotment status. This Robokidz Eduventures IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the NSE IPO at a median premium of ₹82 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹65 to ₹90. The median has climbed ₹38.5 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Trackers differ by about 30.5% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Set against the upper price band of ₹1785, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 4.59% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 5.71× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (59/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the NSE IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 22 Sep, with listing expected 24 Sep 2026. For the NSE IPO, one lot is 8 shares and the issue size is ₹22,562 Cr. See also NSE IPO subscription status and NSE IPO allotment status. This NSE IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

As of today, the Kheria Autocomp IPO grey market premium is ₹3 at the median of 5 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹2 and ₹7. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 166.7% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹101, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 2.97% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.48× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (60/100); the full breakdown is below.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Kheria Autocomp IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 22 Sep, with listing expected 24 Sep 2026. For the Kheria Autocomp IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹46.44 Cr. See also Kheria Autocomp IPO subscription status and Kheria Autocomp IPO allotment status. This Kheria Autocomp IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
No Axiom Gas Engineering IPO grey market premium has been reported yet — all 4 trackers we monitor currently quote ₹0, which usually means grey-market activity simply hasn't started. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.39× overall — modest so far. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (61/100); the full breakdown is below.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Axiom Gas Engineering IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 23 Sep, with listing expected 25 Sep 2026. For the Axiom Gas Engineering IPO, one lot is 2000 shares and the issue size is ₹49.81 Cr. See also Axiom Gas Engineering IPO subscription status and Axiom Gas Engineering IPO allotment status. This Axiom Gas Engineering IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the Axiom Gas Engineering IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The Axiom Gas Engineering IPO is subscribed 1.39 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.q: What is the Axiom Gas Engineering IPO lot size?
subscription_faq.a: One lot of the Axiom Gas Engineering IPO is 2000.0 shares, at a price band of Rs 54.0.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get Axiom Gas Engineering IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the SS Retail IPO at a median premium of ₹160 — the midpoint of 3 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹160 to ₹163. That is ₹15.5 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Set against the upper price band of ₹424, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 37.74% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 64.24× overall — strong. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (73/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. See also SS Retail IPO subscription status. This SS Retail IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the SS Retail IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The SS Retail IPO is subscribed 64.24 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.q: When does the SS Retail IPO close?
subscription_faq.a: The SS Retail IPO bidding window is 16-Sep to 18-Sep. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get SS Retail IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.
